posts.title: Ramble about nothing
posts.description: The following post is an unstructured ramble in which nothing really happens. The day started with a game of tennis at 1030. We won 7-5, somewhat to my surprise as I was sure we'd lost. To be honest, I don't really keep scores, or how many games we've won, or not. It's not important to me. posts.title: Focusing
posts.description: I'm finding it really hard to focus on playing games these days. In fact, I'm having trouble focusing on anything these days, and I'm not talking about the floaters in my eyes either. YouTube, Spotify, Pocket Cast, all these great apps for listening to music and podcasts I struggle with - complete attention deficit, can't focus. posts.title: I've stopped watching photography videos on YouTube
posts.description: Yeah, that basically. With a few exceptions. I know, I can hear you, I feel you reaching for that back button. It's a misleading title, sorry about that. But in the main, I've culled my list of 'Following' from around 15 to five. The five I've kept I've either followed for a long time, or I like their work, or they're not trying to sell you gear, of presets, or use Leica's. Except for one. Pffff,
